associations.rationale: This construction directly realizes a two-sided ideal as a left ideal, which is one half of the stated simultaneous structure.
This construction directly realizes a two-sided ideal as a right ideal, which is the other half of the stated simultaneous structure.
This lemma characterizes membership after viewing a two-sided ideal as a left ideal; it supports the construction rather than defining the left-ideal structure itself.
This lemma characterizes membership after viewing a two-sided ideal as a right ideal; it supports the construction rather than defining the right-ideal structure itself.
